semantics.operation: Combinational pairwise bit equality for ordered inputs [a,b,c,d,e].
semantics.mapping: out[24 - (5*row + column)] compares inputs[row] with inputs[column].
semantics.evidence: Original examples assign out[24]=~a^a, out[23]=~a^b, out[22]=~a^c, out[1]=~e^d, out[0]=~e^e.
semantics.cycle_reset_initialization: No clock, reset, storage, or initialization specified; output continuously follows inputs with no added latency.

numeric.width: Each comparison is one bit; out is [24:0].
numeric.logic: Use bitwise XNOR, equivalent to the original ~left ^ right expression; X/Z inputs propagate unknown comparison results.

verification.oracle: Independently index ordered inputs and compute equality for all 25 pairs.
verification.coverage: Exhaust all 32 binary input combinations, plus directed X/Z input cases matching original bitwise expressions.
verification.sampling: Allow combinational settling after each input change; no clock sampling.
verification.completion: Fatal on mismatch and bounded timeout; print PASS only after every check.
